note: Broad candidate class mapping for human review; task membership is multi-label and non-exclusive.

classes.title: Fixed output colour
classes.description: Output colour can be hardcoded or selected from a fixed small set.

classes.title: Preserve input colour
classes.description: Output keeps arbitrary input colours on copied/moved cells.

classes.title: Copy marker/object colour
classes.description: Colour is selected from a marker, hint, or source object.

classes.title: Recolour by rule
classes.description: Input colours are mapped to different output colours.

classes.title: Colour by count/mode/rank
classes.description: Colour comes from count, mode, rank, argmax, or palette statistics.

classes.title: Palette/LUT remap
classes.description: Colour choice is naturally a small lookup table or channel remap.

classes.title: Fixed template
classes.description: Shape is fixed or from a tiny constant template.

classes.title: Copy object shape
classes.description: Shape is copied from an input object/component.

classes.title: Clone/duplicate shape
classes.description: A shape is repeated one or more times.

classes.title: Extend line/ray
classes.description: Line, ray, or span is extended from observed marks.

classes.title: Bounding box/rectangle
classes.description: Shape is a bbox, solid rectangle, frame, or rectangular interior.

classes.title: Enclosed fill
classes.description: Output fills holes/enclosed background regions.

classes.title: Local stencil
classes.description: Cell state depends mainly on a local neighbourhood.

classes.title: Connected component
classes.description: Rule depends on connected components or object grouping.

classes.title: Row/column profile
classes.description: Rule can be read from row/column counts, bands, or separators.

classes.title: Template match
classes.description: Small template/sprite is matched, rotated, or stamped.

classes.title: No/fixed direction
classes.description: No dynamic direction, or direction is a fixed constant.

classes.title: Axis-aligned direction
classes.description: Uses horizontal/vertical rows, columns, bars, or spans.

classes.title: Diagonal direction
classes.description: Uses diagonal or slanted relationships.

classes.title: Marker-relative direction
classes.description: Direction or target is inferred from marker/hint placement.

classes.title: Rotation/reflection candidate
classes.description: Needs orientation, flip, rotation, or dihedral candidates.

classes.title: Gravity/drop direction
classes.description: Objects move/drop/fall toward an edge or obstacle.

classes.title: Copy
classes.description: Output copies cells/objects from input.

classes.title: Move/translate
classes.description: Object is shifted to a different location.

classes.title: Clone/repeat
classes.description: Object/template is repeated or tiled.

classes.title: Extend
classes.description: Existing marks are extended into lines/spans/rays.

classes.title: Fill
classes.description: Region is filled or completed.

classes.title: Crop/resize
classes.description: Output crops, pads, resizes, upscales, or downscales.

classes.title: Erase/filter/select
classes.description: Some input content is removed or a subset is selected.

classes.title: Reorder/pack/sort
classes.description: Objects are sorted, packed, ranked, or rearranged.

classes.title: Same position
classes.description: Output changes colour/value at same positions.

classes.title: Fixed offset
classes.description: Placement is a constant translation/offset.

classes.title: Marker target
classes.description: Placement is controlled by markers or target slots.

classes.title: Grid repeat/tile
classes.description: Placement follows a repeated grid/lattice/tile.

classes.title: Canonical crop/top-left
classes.description: Output is canonicalized to a crop, bbox, or top-left origin.

classes.title: Direct output algebra
classes.description: Emit thresholded final output without full intermediate carriers.

classes.title: Direct one-hot gather
classes.description: Route input one-hot channels directly to output.

classes.title: Final Equal/overlay
classes.description: Carry scalar labels or masks until final Equal/Where output.

classes.title: Single Conv/QLinearConv
classes.description: Collapse local predicates/counts into one Conv/QLinearConv family.

classes.title: Tiny LUT/Gather
classes.description: Use small lookup tables, Gather, or channel remap.

classes.title: Einsum symbolic
classes.description: Use algebraic contraction or selector factorization.

classes.title: Roi/crop/pool primitive
classes.description: Use RoiAlign, MaxRoiPool, Resize, GridSample, or crop primitives.

classes.title: Sparse scatter/edit stream
classes.description: Use sparse coordinate updates instead of full masks where safe.

classes.title: Bounded scan/flood-fill
classes.description: Use MaxPool/CumSum/scan, ideally cropped or compressed.

classes.title: QLinear/uint8 compression
classes.description: Replace fp32/fp16 routing with uint8/QLinear exact forms.

classes.title: Mem0 param game
classes.description: Memory is zero/tiny; improvements must reduce params.

classes.title: Full label plane floor
classes.description: A 30x30 scalar label/mask carrier likely dominates.

classes.title: Full one-hot floor
classes.description: A 10-channel full-canvas carrier likely dominates.

classes.title: Connectivity wall
classes.description: Flood-fill/component connectivity is the hard cost driver.

classes.title: Assignment wall
classes.description: Matching/correspondence/ambiguous assignment is the hard cost driver.

classes.title: Exact-preserve rewrite target
classes.description: Current source is exact-preserve or low-semantics and should be challenged.
